name: Paladin Oath of the Valkyrie
body:
Even if the valkyries are chaotic creatures, valkyries as a character class can have any alignment; paladins can respect their valor in battle, and the sacred role they play in honoring the fallen and ensuring their rightful place in the afterlife. Especially paladins in service of Norse deities take the oath of the valkyrie. Both male and female paladins can take this oath.

Requirements
Alignment: Any good; if the paladin serves a deity, her alignment must be within one step of her deity’s, along either the law/chaos axis or the good/evil axis.
Archetype Features
Rage Powers

Whenever the paladin could select a mercy, she can instead gain a rage power as a barbarian of her same level. These powers only function while the paladin’s smite evil ability is active. If a rage power requires a target, it must be the target of the paladin’s smiting.

Channel Death

At 4th level, the paladin channels positive energy using the Death variant channeling UM. This modifies channel positive energy.

Aura of Victory (Su)

At 14th level, whenever the paladin enters combat, all friendly creatures within 10 feet that can see her at the beginning of her turn gain temporary hit points equal to the paladin’s Charisma bonus (minimum 1); any enemy creature starting its turn within 10 feet of the paladin suffers instead a number of nonlethal damage points equal to half the paladin’s level (Will save negates, DC = 10 + ½ the paladin’s level + her Charisma bonus).

This replaces aura of faith.

True Valkyrie (Su)

At 20th level, the paladin becomes a veritable messenger of life and death. Her DR increases to 10/evil. Whenever she uses smite evil, the paladin assumes the brilliant, glowing form of a true valkyrie: angelic wings sprout from her back, giving her a flying speed of 90 feet.

Once for every time she takes this form, the paladin can draw the soul from one recently deceased body (no more than one day dead) and store it within her weapon to take it to its place of final rest, as soul bind. The dead creature must be willing to have its soul taken for this part of the power to have an effect. In addition, while in true valkyrie form, the paladin can cast plane shift once per day.

This replaces holy champion.

Code of Conduct

Bring a swift death to worthy enemies; witness heroic deeds on the battlefield and share their stories; provide aid and support to your allies; honor the fallen and administer last rites for them.

Oath Spells: 1st—deathwatch; 2nd—gentle repose; 3rd—rage; 4th—divine power.
